nodes.name: When Executed by Another Workflow
nodes.notes: Receives the Simpro event exactly as the router has it: { body: { name, reference: { companyID, <type>ID } } }. Input data mode must read 'Accept all data'.

nodes.name: Workflow Config
nodes.notes: EDIT HERE: namePrefix = what a Site / Company customer / Quote / Job name must start with (case-sensitive). contactEmailDomains = comma-separated email domains that make a Contact a test record. Simpro API base URL.

assignments.name: recordPath

nodes.name: Build Simpro Record Path
nodes.notes: Maps the event type to its Simpro API path (same paths the router uses). Unknown types give an empty path.

nodes.name: Known Record Type
nodes.notes: True → fetch the record. False → not a Site / Company customer / Contact / Quote / Job event, so it is not a test record.

nodes.name: Get Simpro Record
nodes.notes: Fetches the record that triggered the event so its current name can be checked.

nodes.name: Return Check Result
nodes.notes: Output to the router: the original event plus recordName and isTestRecord. Contacts: true when the email domain is in contactEmailDomains. Everything else: true when the name starts with namePrefix.

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ ({ ...$('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json, recordName: '', isTestRecord: false }) }}

nodes.name: Return Not A Test Record
nodes.notes: Unknown event type: returns the original event with isTestRecord false.
